name: io.github.JeenyJAI/mcp-test-utils
title: MCP Test Utils
description: Desktop UI automation for AI agents: verified clicks, UI Automation, OCR, batch, scenario runs

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for logging sessions (opt-in). Without it, logging tools are hidden.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_MAX_MB
environmentVariables.description: Session size limit in MB. Warning on exceed.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_RETAIN_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Auto-delete log sessions older than N days. 0 to disable.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SEARCH_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed directories for search_in_files (semicolon-separated). Without it, the tool is hidden.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NOTIFY
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to hide the tray icon and the live call log window.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_INPUT_LOCK
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to disable the keyboard and mouse lock while the server sends input (on by default; Esc stops).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_INPUT_LOCK_STALL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Silence of the server in ms after which the input lock lets the input go.
